Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D pixel-art DEATH sprite sheet for a top-down survival game. Input image is ONLY a character identity / palette / camera reference: four existing views left to right SOUTH/front, WEST/left, EAST/right, NORTH/back. Create new hand-posed death animation artwork of this SAME character; do not reproduce reference layout.
Subject: Thin infected man, bald pale head, torn olive short sleeve shirt, charcoal trousers, brown shoes. Quick loss of balance, knees buckle, crumples to the ground.
Exact output: transparent PNG 1536x1024, invisible grid 6 columns by 4 rows, each cell 256x256. Exactly 24 isolated sprites, no extras, no text or grid. Row0 SOUTH/front facing, row1 WEST/left profile, row2 EAST/right profile, row3 NORTH/back facing. Keep the matching facing through every pose; back row has back of head and back of clothing with no face. Camera fixed elevated top-down 3/4 as reference, NEVER camera orbit or rotation of flat art.
Each row is ONE genuine progressive 6-frame death, read left to right: (0) alive upright at moment of fatal impact; (1) knees buckle and torso droops; (2) hips drop and body tilts halfway toward ground; (3) torso hits ground with limbs folding; (4) nearly settled horizontal prone/side lying corpse; (5) final entirely motionless horizontal dead body on ground, limbs relaxed. Last two are settling poses, NOT resurrection. South falls forward head toward bottom, north falls forward head toward top/back visible, west falls head left, east falls head right. Each terminal body still recognizable as the same infected.
Layout safety: every sprite fully inside its 256x256 cell with at least 24 transparent pixels margin. Same character scale in every column, NO zooming/shrinking as it falls. First upright sprite height about 165 pixels. All poses pivot around a fixed local ground point (128,190) in each cell; do not vertically recenter each pose, body descends from upright to ground. Corpse can extend horizontally but stays within cell margins. Crisp deliberate square pixel clusters, dark olive/charcoal/warm fungal orange palette, same pixel density as reference, consistent upper left light. Transparent alpha background only. No floor, shadows, blood pools, particles, hit flashes, blur, glow, weapons, detached body parts, gore, captions, logos. Important: the 6 sprites in each row must genuinely CHANGE posture progressively; don't just move, scale, rotate, or repeat the standing sprite. Corpse truly lying flat, NOT a kneeling wounded character.
